method.input: Identical prepared Java RowData and Rust Arrow RecordBatch values. Generic/binary stock input as indicated. Runtime nullable ascending and null-order flags; distinct control instances.
method.stock: Released Flink generated expression, dependencies opened through the production binding, evalRow and typed complete-array consumption timed in Java.
method.previous: Production whole-Calc kind38 with generated released Flink ARRAY_SLICE and ARRAY_SORT, Arrow import/export and JNI callback intrinsic to that operation timed inside Rust.
method.candidate: Production Calc expression with slice170 and sort217, prepared Arrow batches, complete typed Arrow array consumption timed inside Rust. No JVM callback.
method.preparation: Inputs, function specialization, lifecycle and native expression compilation are outside timers. Both native paths run and are compared for complete output schema and value parity before timing; each trial checks all-engine checksums.
method.perimeter: Initial Arrow import, final output export and row/Arrow transposes are excluded only from the small-function timer. Intrinsic previous callback conversions remain included.
method.order: Rotate all three engines each trial in one JVM per input profile.

pipeline_method.order: Fresh JVMs: stock, previous, candidate. No CPU pinning.
pipeline_method.timer: Planning/submission, execution and row sink included. MiniCluster/environment construction and EXPLAIN route assertions are outside timer. Both RowDataToArrow and ArrowToRowData retained for StreamFusion.
pipeline_method.witness: NativeCalc consumed input metrics for both StreamFusion controls; route is jvm=[] for candidate and bound generated evaluator for previous.
pipeline_method.previous_control: Preceding planner class before candidate benchmark class on the classpath; same release library. ARRAY_SORT code is unchanged by the subsequently merged integer SPLIT_INDEX change.
pipeline_method.limits: One short complete-job profile. No universal end-to-end or sustained-throughput claim.
